_readme: Optional: map a character or group id (see data/characters.json) to an image URL,
and the site will show that image instead of the built-in illustrated portrait.
This is where you can plug in official art from the Church's Media Library
(churchofjesuschrist.org/media) for personal, noncommercial use. Official artwork
is copyrighted, so it is not bundled in this repository - download images you are
licensed to use into assets/art/ and reference them here, e.g.:
Any id left unmapped keeps its illustrated SVG card.
